name: Osmious-Eyot
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs tectonic rift valleys, stark under a black sky.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
monolithic structures of unknown origin still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
